panels.title: Not-ready trend (stuck watch)
panels.description: Workspaces and logical clusters plotted separately so the stuck resource is named. kcp metrics are counts by phase only (no per-object identity) — to list WHICH objects are stuck, use the runbook in docs/alerts-guide.md (wildcard list of tenancy.kcp.io workspaces / core.kcp.io logicalclusters filtered to phase != Ready). Alert baselines 8 — recalibrate per cluster; us-2 has a standing logical-cluster Scheduling count (SRE finding F2). panels.title: Binding conditions not True
panels.description: Any non-zero series here is a degraded binding condition.

panels.title: APIExport conditions (instant)
panels.description: APIExport conditions by shard and status. Only IdentityValid has been observed on us-2 (kcp v0.32.1) — VirtualWorkspaceURLsReady appears in no capture; its absence from the table is expected, not data loss.

targets.expr: sum by (condition) (max by (shard, condition, status) (kcp_apiexport_condition_status{status=~"False|Unknown"})) or vector(0)
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (name, le) (rate(workqueue_work_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$shard_job", name=~"kcp-.*"}[5m]))))

panels.title: Agent up / leader per service
panels.description: Every SCO service needs one live, leading agent.

panels.title: Reconcile errors/s per service
panels.description: The agents' WORK health: an agent can be up and leading while failing every reconcile — tenant claims stop converging with zero errors elsewhere. Sustained non-zero per service = investigate that agent's logs. Metric captured live post-S1 (2026-07-18 fixture).

panels.title: Reconcile p99 duration per service
panels.description: Slow reconciles = slow claim propagation to the service cluster, before anything errors. Complements the error-rate panel the same way ProcessingSlow complements QueueBacklog for the kcp controllers.

panels.title: CPU throttle ratio

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_regex", container!=""}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_regex", container!=""}[5m])), 1))

panels.description: Per container — matches KcpPodCPUThrottled granularity (a pooled per-pod ratio dilutes a throttled container on multi-container pods; audit finding).

panels.title: Restarts (1h)
panels.description: Syncagents have a standing restart baseline on us-2 — investigate separately.

panels.title: Goroutines (kcp components)
panels.description: A sustained climb precedes an OOM.

panels.title: OOM kills (last terminated reason)
panels.description: 1 = this container's LAST termination was an OOM kill (the reason persists until the next termination). Pairs with the KcpPodOOMKilled alert, which additionally requires a restart in the last 30m so it auto-resolves; this panel keeps the history visible after the alert clears.
